title: Tighten Chebyshev's Prime Counting Constants to 0.921 and 1.106

problemStatement.plain: The existing `ChebyshevPNTBridge.lean` proof establishes that $\log 2 \leq \liminf \pi(x)\log(x)/x \leq \limsup \leq 2\log 4$, i.e., constants approximately $0.693$ and $1.386$. Chebyshev's 1852 paper gave tighter bounds: $0.921$ and $1.106$. The goal is to formalize these sharper constants in Lean 4.
